title: Velo Tropical Mango Slim Nicotine Pouches
description: Velo Slim Tropical Mango Nicotine Pouches deliver a vibrant blend of exotic fruit flavours, led by juicy Mango with supporting notes of Mandarin and Passionfruit. The result is a flavour that tastes sweet, rounded and distinctly tropical. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering a practical and flavoursome option wherever you are. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide variety of flavour profiles and strengths. Tropical Mango is offered in two options: a Mild 6mg strength for those who prefer a gentler nicotine experience, and a Medium 10mg strength for users seeking a more potent release. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
